$comment: Single source of truth for the 3D asset forge. Every entry names the existing game file that proves the asset belongs to Exocomplict / NEON FRONTIER, so the list cannot drift into invented content. `verified_by: tools/asset-forge/gate/check_catalog.mjs` asserts each `source` path exists and each `id` has a reference image and a model module.

entries.name: Reactor Core
entries.role: Central suspended cyan/emerald reactor; combat lane stays open underneath.

entries.name: Command Centre
entries.role: West outpost: armoured hull, raised command bridge, visor windows, antenna mast and dish.

entries.name: Research Laboratory
entries.role: Ceramic lab shell with a glass sampling vessel and sample core.

entries.name: Equipment Depot
entries.role: Supply depot with stacked cargo and a service frame.

entries.name: Generator Bank
entries.role: Three contained generator towers with luminous energy columns and feed pipes.

entries.name: Landing Pad
entries.role: Raised vehicle apron with safety edges and beacon lights.

entries.name: Boss Gate
entries.role: Reinforced docking frame with shutter leaves that open once the generators are down.

entries.name: Defence Turret
entries.role: Yaw bearing, armoured housing, twin barrels, optical sensor.

entries.name: Sensor Tower
entries.role: Structural shaft with observation cabin, radar plates and dishes.

entries.name: Wrecked Transport
entries.role: Broken hull, glazed cockpit, separated wings, engines, hot impact damage.

entries.name: Alien Drone Wreck
entries.role: Chassis, luminous sensor core, broken articulated arms and claw plates.

entries.name: Crystal Cluster
entries.role: Tapered cyan/emerald/turquoise mineral shards on geological roots.

entries.name: Alien Flora
entries.role: Luminous buds, varied leaves and arching fronds.

entries.name: Enemy Spawn Gate
entries.role: Open arch frame with warning panels, cyan guide strips and beacons; passage stays clear.

entries.name: Cover Module
entries.role: Segmented waist-high armoured cover with hazard top marking and signal panels.
